messages:
sarah lee: Quick heads-up — onboarding EU bank with customer-managed HSM. They will keep CMK in their HSM and we need to support a proxy signing flow within their VPC. Need guidance on RBAC roles, audit retention, and an incident "break-glass" flow. Anyone with prior bank onboarding notes?

mike p: I can draft RBAC. Minimal roles: hsm-proxy-runner, hsm-proxy-admin (very restricted), hsm-audit-reader. No direct key material access in our tenant. :thumbsup:

mike p: Example minimal policy snippet:
```
resource: hsm-proxy
actions: [start, stop, send-sign-request]
conditions: {vpc: customer-vpc-*/subnet: private-*}
roles: [hsm-proxy-runner]
```

jordan ops: Ops notes — proxy will live in customer VPC as a container with mTLS to their HSM. We'll only get opaque signatures and short-lived attestation tokens. Audit logs must be forwarded to their SIEM via syslog/rsyslog — we shouldn't persist raw HSM responses in our logs. :lock:

daria (compliance): For EU financials, retention depends: payments-related logs often require 5-7 years, but PSD2 / local regs can push to 10. Also require signed custody attestations and a chain-of-custody record for any key operations we perform. We need an onboarding checklist: attestations, legal T&Cs, export controls, DPA addendum.

ana: From infra: we should implement RBAC as permissioned roles in our control plane + a gate that mints per-request ephemeral tokens scoped to a single operation. Also add a feature flag to route this customer to a dedicated proxy pool and enable 'emergency-disable' boolean.

sarah lee: Good. Can someone write an incident playbook for key availability / suspected exfil? E.g., revoke ephemeral tokens, fail open vs fail closed options, notify customer, rotate fallback keys.

mike p: Draft steps:
1) Immediate: disable proxy-runner service, revoke active tokens
2) Notify legal + compliance + customer
3) Collect logs (make sure we have signed syslog + syscall traces) — preserve chain-of-custody
4) If confirmed compromise: require customer key rotation and re-attestation

jordan ops: Ops question — do we need the ability to perform a wrap/unwrap on our side (server-side wrapping) or strictly proxy sign only? Customer prefers strict proxy-sign only. If server-side wrap required, that's a different custody boundary and needs KMS integration + HSM import APIs.

daria (compliance): Strong recommendation: avoid server-side wrapping unless the customer explicitly permits it in writing and we add HSM import/import-approval steps to the audit trail.

deploy-bot: canary deployment for hsm-proxy-v1 completed in eu-west-1 at 2123456830 :white_check_mark:

sarah lee: OK, next actions: @mike p to post RBAC YAML + proposed playbook by EOD, @jordan ops to draft syslog forwarding configuration, @daria (compliance) to confirm retention numbers with legal, @ana to add feature flag and emergency disable. I'll sync with the customer tomorrow. Thanks all. :pray:
